issues.title: Inconsistent spacing around function arguments
issues.description: The code contains inconsistent spacing around commas in function arguments that violates the project's rustfmt configuration. Specifically, missing space after comma and extra spaces after comma in method calls.
issues.rule_name: Rust Code Must Be Formatted According to Project rustfmt Configuration

issues.title: Cookie deletion incorrectly calls SetCookie instead of DeleteCookie
issues.description: The delete_cookie function is sending a WebviewMessage::SetCookie message instead of WebviewMessage::DeleteCookie. This causes the cookie to be set/updated instead of being deleted when the delete_cookie API is called. Any code attempting to delete cookies will fail to remove them, and may inadvertently persist or update cookies that should be removed. This breaks the entire cookie deletion functionality and creates a security concern where sensitive cookies cannot be properly removed.

issues.title: Window size applied before position in window_features causing incorrect window placement
issues.description: In the window_features method, the size configuration is now applied before the position configuration, reversing the original order. This can lead to incorrect window positioning behavior because some window managers calculate the final window position based on the current window size. When the size is set after the position, the position may be recalculated or adjusted incorrectly. This particularly affects windows opened through the on_new_window handler when both size and position are specified in NewWindowFeatures.

issues.title: Changed window naming pattern breaks window label consistency
issues.description: The window label format for dynamically created windows has been changed from "new-{number}" to "new-window-{number}". This breaks the established naming convention and will cause any code that attempts to retrieve or manipulate these windows using the expected label format to fail. For example, code trying to access "new-0" or "new-1" will not find the windows, as they are now named "new-window-0" and "new-window-1". This affects window management, event handling, and any window lookup operations that depend on the label pattern.

issues.title: Public re-export lacks rustdoc documentation
issues.description: A new public API item (`pub use tauri_runtime::Cookie;`) was added without a `///` documentation comment. Line comments (`// ...`) do not satisfy the rule requiring rustdoc comments for public APIs.
issues.problematic_code_snippet:
// Remove this re-export in v3
pub use tauri_runtime::Cookie;
issues.rule_name: Public APIs Must Include Documentation Comments

issues.title: New code uses unwrap() on fallible operations
issues.description: Added code introduces multiple `unwrap()` calls on fallible operations (`parse().unwrap()`, `set_title(...).unwrap()`, and `build().unwrap()`), which violates the rule prohibiting panics/unwraps in favor of explicit error handling via `Result`.
issues.rule_name: Functions Should Return Result Types for Fallible Operations

issues.title: User-facing API change without a .changes entry
issues.description: This PR changes a user-facing API (renaming/replacing `with_window_features` with `window_features` and updating docs/examples accordingly) but does not add any markdown change file under `.changes/` in the diff, violating the requirement to include a covector change file for releasable functionality/API changes.
issues.rule_name: Changes Requiring a Version Bump Must Include a Change File
